newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times page one stories.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times page one stories.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Thursday:
- Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's coalition cabinet endorsed the Hebron agreement by a vote of 11 to 7.
- President Clinton said Mexico had repaid all of the $12.5 billion it borrowed from Washington to stave off a financial collapse two years ago.

- Clinton broke weeks of silence over the ethics investigation against Speaker Newt Gingrich, saying both he and the public are tired of the partisan bickering and urging House members to put it behind them and "get on with it."
- Representatives of the health care industry began an attack on the deep cuts New York governor George Pataki has proposed for the state's Medicaid program.

- The Federal Aviation Administration said it planned to require changes in the rudder controls of all 1,100 Boeing 737's in the United States to preclude a sudden rudder movement that is suspected of playing a role in two unsolved airline crashes in the last six years.
- Some astrophysicists are casting an eye so far ahead that they think they can see the death of the sun and the end of the universe.

- Marxist guerrillas holding 74 hostages at the Japanese Ambassador's residence in Lima, Peru, said they were willing to accept a government proposal to set up a commission to negotiate and end to the seige, now in its fifth week.
